svg.title: Limits and dispositions
svg.desc: - The complete 60-cell performance campaign did not meet full-grid 2× throughput, 30% memory or ≤10% p95-regression gates. Only 3/15 pairs per route were eligible. Across 58,560 planned measured tasks, candidate completed 21,600/29,280 and baseline 1,451/29,280. All 35,509 planned/measured failures stay counted. There were 27 budget aborts, 11 setup/cell errors and three control failures. Candidate’s three heavy matched-WebKit 32-worker cells exceeded the 2 GiB budget. Semantic success at 32 clients is a separate claim.
